blocks.name: The Sun as a star
blocks.definition: Know that the Sun is a star of medium size, consisting mostly of hydrogen and helium, and that it radiates most of its energy in the infrared, visible and ultraviolet regions of the electromagnetic spectrum.

blocks.md:
- The Sun is a **medium-sized star** which lies at the **centre** of the Solar System
- It consists mostly of the two elements **hydrogen** and **helium**
- It radiates most of its energy in the **infrared**, **visible** and **ultraviolet** regions of the electromagnetic spectrum

blocks.alt: A large, glowing orange-red sphere with a mottled, turbulent surface and several bright yellow solar flares around its edge.
blocks.caption: The Sun is a medium-sized star consisting of mostly hydrogen and helium

blocks.name: Nuclear fusion in stars
blocks.definition: Know that stars are powered by nuclear reactions that release energy and that in stable stars the nuclear reactions involve the fusion of hydrogen into helium

blocks.md:
- Stars are huge balls of (mostly) **hydrogen** gas
- In the centre of a star, hydrogen nuclei undergo [nuclear fusion](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/physics/cie/23/revision-notes/1-motion-forces-and-energy/1-8-energy-sources/1-8-5-nuclear-fusion/?_ai=internal-linking) to form helium nuclei
